name: marketing-specialist
description: Marketing and social media fundamentals: marketing principles, content strategy, social media platforms, SEO basics, analytics, copywriting, and brand management. Built on top of high-school-graduate base.

facts.fact: The marketing mix (4 Ps) consists of Product, Price, Place, and Promotion, which are the core elements of a marketing strategy
facts.query: marketing mix 4 Ps product price place promotion

facts.fact: A target audience is the specific group of consumers a marketing campaign aims to reach, defined by demographics, interests, and behavior
Brand awareness is the degree to which consumers recognize and recall a brand and its products
A value proposition is a statement explaining what a product does, who it serves, and why it is better than alternatives
Customer acquisition cost (CAC) is the total cost of marketing and sales divided by the number of new customers acquired
facts.query: customer acquisition cost CAC marketing sales

facts.fact: Return on investment (ROI) measures the profitability of marketing spend, calculated as (revenue minus cost) divided by cost times 100
facts.query: ROI return on investment marketing profitability

facts.fact: A call to action (CTA) is a prompt that tells the audience what to do next, such as Buy Now, Sign Up, or Learn More
facts.query: call to action CTA buy sign up

facts.fact: A conversion occurs when a user completes a desired action, such as making a purchase or signing up for a newsletter
A/B testing compares two versions of a marketing asset to determine which performs better based on a measured metric
facts.query: A/B testing compare versions performance metric

facts.fact: The marketing funnel represents the customer journey from awareness through interest, consideration, purchase, and loyalty
facts.query: marketing funnel awareness consideration purchase loyalty

facts.fact: Content marketing creates and distributes valuable, relevant content to attract and retain a defined audience, ultimately driving profitable action
An editorial calendar schedules content publication across platforms and dates to maintain consistency
A blog post is an article published on a website that provides information, opinion, or storytelling to engage readers
A content pillar is a core topic that branches into multiple related pieces of content across formats
facts.query: content pillar core topic related pieces

facts.fact: Evergreen content remains relevant over time and continues to attract traffic long after publication, unlike news or trend-based content
A lead magnet is a free resource offered in exchange for contact information, such as an ebook, checklist, or webinar
facts.query: lead magnet free resource contact information

facts.fact: Repurposing content means adapting one piece into multiple formats, such as turning a blog post into a video, infographic, and social posts
User-generated content (UGC) is content created by customers or fans, such as reviews, photos, or testimonials, which builds trust and authenticity
facts.query: user generated content UGC reviews testimonials

facts.fact: A content management system (CMS) like WordPress or Shopify is software for creating, editing, and publishing digital content
facts.query: CMS content management system WordPress Shopify

facts.fact: Storytelling in marketing uses narrative techniques to create emotional connections with the audience
Facebook is the largest social media platform by users, suited for community building, targeted ads, and event promotion
facts.query: Facebook largest social media community ads

facts.fact: Instagram focuses on visual content (photos, reels, stories) and is effective for brand aesthetics and product showcases
facts.query: Instagram visual content reels stories aesthetics

facts.fact: LinkedIn is the professional networking platform, ideal for B2B marketing, recruiting, and thought leadership content
TikTok features short-form video content driven by trends and algorithms, effective for reaching younger demographics
facts.query: TikTok short video trends younger demographics

facts.fact: X (formerly Twitter) is a real-time platform for news, customer service, and short-form commentary in 280 characters
facts.query: X Twitter real-time news customer service 280

facts.fact: YouTube is the second largest search engine and the primary platform for long-form video content and tutorials
Pinterest is a visual discovery platform where users save pins, effective for lifestyle, DIY, and e-commerce marketing
An engagement rate measures how actively audiences interact with content, calculated as total interactions divided by followers times 100
A hashtag is a keyword prefixed with a pound sign that categorizes content and makes it discoverable on social platforms
Social media scheduling tools like Buffer and Hootsuite allow marketers to plan and automate posts across multiple platforms
facts.query: scheduling tools Buffer Hootsuite automate posts

facts.fact: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) improves a website's visibility in organic search results to increase traffic
facts.query: SEO search engine optimization organic traffic

facts.fact: Keywords are the search terms people use in search engines, and keyword research identifies high-value terms to target
On-page SEO includes optimizing title tags, meta descriptions, headings, content, and internal links on a webpage
facts.query: on-page SEO title tag meta description headings

facts.fact: Off-page SEO includes building backlinks from other websites, which signals authority and trust to search engines
Google Analytics tracks website traffic, user behavior, conversions, and other metrics to measure marketing performance
Bounce rate is the percentage of visitors who leave a website after viewing only one page without further interaction
facts.query: bounce rate leave one page visitors

facts.fact: Page load speed affects both user experience and search rankings, with Google preferring sites that load in under 3 seconds
A conversion rate is the percentage of visitors who complete a desired action, calculated as conversions divided by total visitors times 100
Domain authority is a score (1-100) predicting how well a website ranks on search engines, based on backlinks and quality
SEM (Search Engine Marketing) uses paid advertising on search engines, such as Google Ads, to appear at the top of results
facts.query: SEM search engine marketing paid Google Ads

facts.fact: Copywriting is writing persuasive text (copy) for marketing materials, advertisements, and digital content to drive action
A headline is the most important element of any copy, as it determines whether people read the rest
The AIDA model describes the stages of marketing communication: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action
Brand voice is the consistent personality and tone a brand uses across all communications
A tagline is a short, memorable phrase that captures a brand's essence, such as Nike's Just Do It
Social proof uses testimonials, reviews, and user numbers to build trust and influence purchasing decisions
FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) is a marketing technique that creates urgency by highlighting limited availability or time-sensitive offers
facts.query: FOMO fear missing out urgency limited

facts.fact: An elevator pitch is a concise, compelling summary of a product or business that can be delivered in 30 seconds or less
Emotional appeal in copywriting connects with the audience's feelings and desires, which is often more persuasive than logical arguments alone
A brand guideline document specifies logo usage, color palette, typography, and tone of voice to ensure consistent branding
facts.query: brand guidelines logo colors typography consistent
